description: This Java class is a Spring Boot exception handler that intercepts all exceptions thrown within the application and provides a standardized error response, mainly used for handling unexpected server errors.

classes.name: ApiExceptionHandler
classes.description: Centralized exception handler for capturing and responding to all exceptions in a Spring Boot application, returning a standardized error response.

methods.name: handleDefaultException
methods.description: Handles all general exceptions by returning a 500 Internal Server Error response with a generic error message.

methods.name: createErrorResponse
methods.description: A static helper method to create an ErrorResponse builder initialized with current timestamp and HTTP status code.
